    JobShopGoal.MinimizeMakespan
    Minimize the makespan (time the last operation ends).
    static final record 
    JobShopGoal.MinimizeMakespanAndTardiness
    Minimize makespanWeight * makespan + tardinessWeight * totalWeightedTardiness.
    static final record 
    JobShopGoal.MinimizeTardiness
    Minimize the weighted sum of operation tardiness (weight * sum(jobWeight * max(0, end - due))) over operations that carry a due date.

    JobShopGoal.MinimizeWeightedCompletionTime
    Minimize sum(jobWeight * completionTime) over all jobs, where completion is the end of the last operation.
